protocol.claim_boundary: fixed-weight descriptive decomposition of matched-target cue-order sensitivity; no channel, routing, adaptation, learning, or causal claim
protocol.fitting_rule: For every condition, fit projection, cue6 decoder, normalization, and temporal tracker solely on base-order train32. Apply unchanged objects to paired heldout eval32. No heldout-order state, label, transform, or threshold may fit an object.
protocol.matched_target_rule: Each condition applies its exact listed permutation jointly to symbols and reliabilities. Base and heldout paired histories retain the same complete symbol-reliability evidence-pair multiset and public log-odds target, subject to recorded floating-point tolerance 1e-12.
protocol.primary_outcome: continuous_transport_margin = heldout orthogonal true-label R2 - max(heldout analytic latest-cue R2, heldout conditional-shuffle R2); also report true-minus-latest and true-minus-shuffle separately
protocol.secondary_outcome: strict transport pass when continuous_transport_margin is positive
protocol.seed_level_aggregation: For every condition, delay and parameter seed, use the median continuous transport margin across the three projection seeds. Projection and checkpoint cells remain dependent descriptive measurements.
protocol.target_rule: Each condition applies its exact listed permutation jointly to symbols and reliabilities. Base and heldout paired histories retain the same complete symbol-reliability evidence-pair multiset and public log-odds target, subject to recorded floating-point tolerance 1e-12.
